_meta.title: Spain: hate-crime incidents recorded by police, by province, 2014-2024
_meta.measures: Incidents related to hate crimes known to the police ("hechos conocidos"), as recorded in the Sistema Estadístico de Criminalidad (Guardia Civil, Policía Nacional, regional police forces and local police that report to it). "value" is known_all = all known hate incidents (criminal offences plus administrative infractions/other incidents), all motives, latest year. Series: known_* (incidents known), cleared_* (incidents solved, "hechos esclarecidos"), victims_* (victimisations), arrested_investigated_* (persons arrested or investigated, criminal offences only). Motive part: all, racism_xenophobia, sexual_orientation_gender_identity, ideology, sex_gender, religion, disability, antisemitism, antigypsyism, islamophobia, aporophobia (hostility to poor people), age, illness. Suffix _criminal = criminal offences only; _admin_other = administrative infractions and other incidents; no suffix = total. For victims and arrests the suffix is sex (_male, _female, _legal_person, _unknown_sex); no suffix = total. All figures are summed over every offence type ("Total tipo"). The per-offence-type breakdown is in the companion CSV.
notes: 2014-2020 come from the "Histórico delitos de odio anteriores a 2021" tables, 2021-2024 from the current tables, same structure.
Islamophobia was first coded separately in 2024 (earlier years show 0 in the source).
País Vasco: the source says its data must be read with the explanatory note in the portal methodology (the Ertzaintza reports separately).
Rows "Total Nacional", "En el extranjero" (abroad) and "Desconocido" (unknown place) are kept as features without geometry.
